introTagline: The missing link between buyers and suppliers.

beats.shot: Open IN the product on the Inbox — the live queue of incoming purchase orders. Cursor settles over the 'needs review' order at the top of the list.
beats.vo: This is your inbox — every purchase order coming in, from every buyer. One just landed that needs a few minutes. Let's take it all the way to delivered.

beats.shot: Cut to the order in review (PO-2024-005678, Nordic Electronics → ElectroSupply Co). Header sweep: the PO number, the buyer, the supplier it's going to, and a progress bar from received to delivered.
beats.vo: Here it is. The PO number, the buyer it came from, ElectroSupply Co — the supplier it's going to — and exactly how far along it is. Four lines, and two still need a decision.

beats.shot: Cursor moves to the Fix Queue rail (Open issues list) — only the two lines that need a decision are listed; the resolved lines aren't in the way.
beats.vo: ProcuLink doesn't make you re-check the whole order. It surfaces only the lines that actually need you — here, two of the four.

beats.shot: Select the resistor line. The AI suggestion card shows the supplier's code, an 84% confidence, and the reason. Hover it, then click Accept; the line resolves and the queue advances.
beats.vo: The first line, a resistor, has no supplier code yet. ProcuLink suggests one — drawn from this supplier's own catalog — with a confidence score and the reason behind it. It's right, so accept it. Done.

beats.shot: Next open line, the wire. Click 'Enter manually' → the input opens → type ES-WIRE-22BK-100 → Save. A hint notes it's remembered for next time.
beats.vo: The last one you'd rather decide yourself. Type the supplier's code, save — and ProcuLink remembers it, so next time this line resolves on its own.

beats.shot: Cursor rests on the Send-readiness card: lines four of four resolved, plus the supplier-acceptance, conformance and delivery checks.
beats.vo: Now the honest pre-send check. Every line resolved, four of four — and right here, the supplier's acceptance rules, the format conformance, and the delivery channel, all in one place before anything goes out.

beats.shot: Click 'Send to supplier' → the confirm dialog opens (total, lines, the exact output format) → tick the checkbox → click the final Send.
beats.vo: So send it. One confirmation, and ProcuLink builds the exact format ElectroSupply requires and delivers it on their channel — no reformatting by hand.

beats.shot: The status runs Generating → Sent → Delivered; the audit-trail banner lands. Cursor rests on the Delivered state.
beats.vo: Generating. Sent. Delivered. And every step is logged, so there's a record for this order that you can show anyone — proof it went out, in the right shape.

beats.shot: Quick aside: sidebar → Exceptions (plain-language queue), then System health (worker heartbeat, requeue). Cursor glances across both, doesn't linger.
beats.vo: And when an order can't go out, nothing fails silently. Problems land here in plain language, and one glance at system health tells you the pipeline is moving.

beats.shot: Sidebar → Dashboard. Rest on the live order-flow view, calm close.
beats.vo: That was one order, handled in a couple of minutes. The next one takes even less. ProcuLink — the missing link between buyers and suppliers. Start free today.
